integrity: Mathematical proof is provided, with a standalone exhaustive finite-case checker; finite testing is not a proof of the universal claim. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts one-step Rule 90 inverse fibers up to rotation only; it does not classify long-term dynamics or other alphabets/rules. Earlier linear-state and adjacent-XOR necklace techniques are acknowledged; historical priority from unindexed Ducci-map literature remains a risk.
title: The four-valued predecessor law for cyclic Rule 90 necklaces
